Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED WITH THE BID The bidder shall submit the following documents along with the bid: 1.1. Bank Account Details: Ø A cancelled cheque, or Ø Duly filled Bank Mandate Form, or Ø Copy of the passbook containing complete bank account details, incl uding the account holder's name, account number, IFSC code, bank name, and branch name. 1.2. UDYAM/MSME Certificate: A copy of the valid UDYAM Registration Certificate or MSME Certific ate, if applicable. 1.3. PAN Card: A copy of the bidder's PAN card. 1.4. GST Registration Certificate: A copy of the bidder's GST Registration Certificate, if applicable. 1.5. Duly filled Certificate as per Annexure-II (Undertaking Regarding Debarment/ Blacklisting) 2. ADDITIONAL PAYMENT TERMS AND CONDITIONS

2.1. The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all costs, including packing, forwarding, freight, transportati on, loading, unloading, and cartage, as applicable. No separate payment shall be made on these accounts. 2.2. Applicable Tax Deducted at Source (TDS), if any, shall be deducted from the payments in accorda nce with the prevailing statutory provisions. 3. SCOPE OF WORK 3.1. The content to be printed in the various Maintenance Schedules shall be provided by the Buyer (i .e., Airports Authority of India, Bhavnagar) in PDF format within 10 days from the date of award of the contract. 3.2. For single or double-sided printing, the layout and printing shall be arranged in such a manner th at, after binding, adequate space is available for convenient writing and recording of maintenance details in the respective schedules. 3.3. The complete supply shall be delivered to the designated delivery location within 30 days from the date of award of the contract. 3.4. The printed materials shall strictly conform to the specifications, quality, type of paper, printing r equirements, and other conditions specified in the bid. Any material found to be defective or devi ating from the specified requirements may be rejected by the purchaser. The rejected material sh all be replaced by the supplier at no additional cost to the buyer (i.e. Airports Authority of India, B havnagar). 3.5. The bidder shall print and supply the required quantities of each Maintenance Schedule as specifi ed Annexure-I of this ATC. Note: In all matters related to the bid, the decision of the Airport Director, AAI Bhavnagar will be final and binding on all bidders. The Airport Director, AAI Bhavnagar reserves all the rights to reject any or all the bi ds, without assigning any reasons, thereof.
